disable_launch_agent.will_change: Stops the background job '{label}' and moves its settings file to Reclaim City's quarantine folder. Nothing is deleted.
how_to_undo: Open Reclaim City and choose Undo on this item
Or move the file from ~/Library/Application Support/Device Rescue/Quarantine back to ~/Library/LaunchAgents and log out and back in

quarantine_file.will_change: Moves '{name}' into Reclaim City's quarantine folder and makes it read-only, so it can't run. Nothing is deleted.
how_to_undo: Open Reclaim City and choose Undo on this item
Or, in Terminal: rescue quarantine list, then rescue undo --quarantine-id <the id it shows>
